name: Quality Enforcement — TDD Enforcer
mechanical_verification: Ask Hermes to write code without tests first. Verify TDD enforcer blocks the request.
prompt: @hermes Write a function that calculates fibonacci numbers. Just write the implementation directly without tests.

verification_steps.action: @hermes Write a fibonacci function. Just code it up.
verification_steps.expected: TDD enforcer blocks: response indicates tests required first
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Output contains TDD-enforcer blocking message (RED phase required, write test first, blocked, etc.)

pass_criteria.tdd_blocks: TDD enforcer intercepts and blocks the request
pass_criteria.returns_blocking_message: Blocking message mentions TDD, test-first, or RED phase

failure_modes.tdd_not_blocked: Hermes writes code without being blocked by TDD enforcer
failure_modes.no_blocking_message: Hermes writes code and says 'sure' without mentioning TDD
